questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Semestertiming og mulige fag.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Ved ankomst var jeg blevet gjort bekendt med al relevant information. Vær dog opmærksom på de 100 euro i semestergebyr, det hørte jeg først om 3 måneder før jeg tog afsted.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Der var introseminarer, rundtur og events fra den lokale ESN-afdeling.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Der er mange forskellige portaler, bl.a. en gennem universitet hvor lokale der tager på udveksling kan fremleje deres værelser.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Der kan være store kulturforskellige ift. roomies. Mine havde konsekvent lukkede døre og der var et minimum af social interaktion i lejligheden.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Universitetet i Mannheim hjælper dig gennem processen, og du får alt information i god tid. Det kan virke en anelse uoverskueligt, men det er rimelig overkommeligt.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Du bliver giver en meget grundig guide og tjekliste.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik alle mine 1. prioriteter.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Lad være med at stresse over det. Mannheims universitet er noget mere chill og fleksible end KU.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Generelt er underviserne engagerede, men niveauet er noget lavere end KU. Derudover er særligt andre udvekslingsstuderende meget uengagerede, så barren er lav.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Undervisningsstilen er omtrent den samme, men der er lidt til intet gruppearbejde.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: International criminal law, Advocacy skills, European Taxation law og International Civil and commercial litigation.

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
Underviseren i Advocacy skills en underholdende og formår at gøre faget på lærerigt og hyggeligt. 
Til gengæld er International criminal law kun over zoom og er mildest talt kaotisk, så medmindre de er skiftet til fysisk undervisning bør du undgå det.

What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Ingen

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Mad er markant billigere, både i supermarkeder men særligt på restaurenter. Du kan snildt få en solid hovedret og en stor øl for 150 kroner. Kebab koster normalt 4-6 euro og efter mit budget kunne jeg reelt leve af det.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Der er enormt mange muligheder, men de er elendige til at informere om dem.

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Mange forskellige typer sport, debatklubber, fester osv.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Tag til Schneckenhof og tag ind og se en ishockey-kamp.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Der er mange hyggelige byer i området. Derudover er der i efteråret mange vin- og ølfestivaller.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Ikke den store forskel fra Danmark. Generelt er folk dog høfligere, og de taler ikke engelsk nær så godt som den gennemsnitlige dansker.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: De ansatte i supermarkeder tager deres job rimelig seriøst, så være klar på at pakke din pose hurtigt.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: De mennesker jeg har mødt har været søde og imødekommende.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Tjek eksamensformer. De mundtlige eksamener foregår sammen med 2-3 andre studerende, og du risikere at få en skriftlige eksamen hvor formen blyant og papir. 
Accepter at starten er overvældende. Du kan altid gå i en introvert hi med netflix og wolt når først du har fået venner. 
Rejs! Mannheim er en ufattelig grim by med meget lidt natur, så for at undgå depression bør du tage en tur til Heidelberg eller en af de andre nærliggende byer. Deutsche Bahn giver DSB kamp til stregen ift. forsinkelser men du må tage det som en oplevelse.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Modsat KUA er universitetet ret flot, så brug bibliotekerne til din eksamenslæsning.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Det har været en rar pause fra stress og jag. Der er sjældent noget at forberede eller læse før undervisningen, så der er massere af fritid til at rejse i.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer:
De første to uger. Der sker meget og det sker hele tiden. 
Efter min opfattelse går folk meget hurtigt i sociale grupper, og dem der hverken boede på kollegie eller deltog i de fleste aktiviteter røg ud af fællesskaberne.

questions.question: Any other comments?
questions.answer: Pray for en plads på Studierendenwerks kollegier.

questions.question: Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
